frequency_question: How often does the Department of Education successfully carry out a formal revocation or termination of a recognized accrediting agency's authority within a comparable timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes any formal departmental action or administrative proceeding initiated to strip an agency of its recognized status; excludes voluntary relinquishments or standard renewals.

coverage_note: 3 named; represents the universe of high-stakes ideological or structural agency showdowns with the Department.
known_gaps: Lower-profile agency renewals or quiet withdrawals are excluded as they do not match the high-friction nature of the target question.
skeleton: Formal Department of Education reviews of controversial accrediting agencies resulting in termination versus renewal over the past three decades.
multiplier: 3 major contested agency showdowns resulting in 2 complete terminations and 1 preservation under heavy conditions.
validity_reason: Based on regulatory frameworks set by the Higher Education Act and administrative procedures which remain stable across administrations.
